question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is "time."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****
 

 

__
 
• In the blank, the appropriate word to use is **"time."**
 
• The phrase **"by the time"** is used to indicate a specific point in time or a moment by which a particular event has occurred. (समय या क्षण का एक विशिष्ट बिंदु जिसके द्वारा कोई विशेष घटना घटित हुई हो)
 
 
• **Example**:* **By the time**__ I finish my coffee, the sun will have risen.*
 
 
 
• In this case, it signifies the period up to the point when individuals reach puberty.** **
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.
 
• **Correct paragraph**:

By the __**time**__ we reach puberty, the world has reached us and ______ (2) ______ us to a greater extent than we realize.______ (3) ______ family, friends, school, and society in general ______ (4) ______ by word and example how to be. But people ______ (5) ______ leaders at that moment when they decide for themselves how to be.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• By the moment: **The phrase** "by the moment" **is not a common expression in English. The more standard and idiomatic phrase is **"by the minute" or "by the second," **which means that something is happening very quickly or continuously changing.
 
• **By the age: **The phrase **"by the age"** is often used to describe achievements, milestones, or characteristics reached or attained at a certain age. It indicates a specific point in time, usually referring to the age of a person. (उपलब्धियाँ, मील के पत्थर, या विशेषताएँ जो एक निश्चित आयु तक पहुँची या प्राप्त की गईं)
 
• **By the era: **The phrase **"by the era"** is used to refer to a specific period or historical time characterized by certain events, developments, or conditions. It indicates that something occurred or was prevalent during a particular era or age. (एक विशिष्ट अवधि या ऐतिहासिक समय जो कुछ घटनाओं, विकासों या स्थितियों द्वारा चित्रित होता है)
